notes.title: 🎉 Thank You for a great Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for over [b]110.000 downloads[/b]! Our demo for [b]CoopRooms[/b] was one of the most played during the latest [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 🔥
[/p][p]We just received word from Valve that CoopRooms will be highlighted on the [b]Next Fest Wrap-Up Page[/b] 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]To everyone who played, wishlisted, or shared the game – [b]thank you so much[/b] for the support ❤️[/p][p]
We've been watching several YouTubers play the game, and it's been incredibly exciting to watch! With your feedback we have been able to make the game a better experience already and we're continuing to build in your feedback while the development goes on![/p][p][/p][p]🕹️ If you haven’t tried the demo yet – it’s still live! We’re keeping it online since players have been enjoying it so far and the feedback we're getting is invaluable.[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ And don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] and/or [b]leave a review[/b] if you enjoyed it – it helps a ton![/p]

notes.title: Developers Walkthrough Demo
notes.notes: [p]For Steam Next Fest, we're running a walkthrough of the game on a continuous loop.[/p][p]CoopRooms is a cooperative survival horror game for up to 5 players set in the endless Backrooms. Take photos and videos to progress—and maybe survive. Just one thing: don't scream... the entities are listening.[/p]
